text.tspan: – weight each sample by what proprio CANNOT predict

g.text: module: the visual change proprio explains, subtracted off – what is left is the block
obs['proprio'] = agent [x, y, vx, vy] only
r = ( zt+1 − zt ) − fprop( [ pt ; at ] )
V1 DOWN-weighted motion and collapsed; T3 up-weights what proprio misses
fprop is fit on detached z with its own term, so it cannot lower Lz by shrinking the residual it is measuring
